figures.name: resolution_01_weak_tap
figures.description: Compact normalized response and exact discontinuous entire orders.

figures.name: resolution_02_growth_resolution
figures.description: Explicit type bounds give a conservative sufficient observation radius, not the actual first crossover.

figures.name: resolution_03_prime_precision
figures.description: Exact analytic derivative envelopes and rational integer-depth bounds. No arithmetic series is truncated.

figures.name: resolution_04_prime_depth
figures.description: Analytic brackets for the absolute visibility threshold, together with a cancellation lower bound for subtracting full functions. This is not a computational feasibility claim.

figures.name: resolution_05_signed_detector
figures.description: Exact degree 7 detector for lambda_2=-1-10^-12. The bar chart displays a rigorous tail upper bound, not a truncated estimate of that tail.

figures.name: resolution_06_degree_gap
figures.description: Every polynomial of degree at most 4 has positive norm for delta=10^-12, yet a degree 7 polynomial has negative norm. Degree 5 or 6 is not decided by these certificates.

plotting_convention: Exact rational and analytic certificates are proved in the atlas. Displayed floating values are not directed-rounding intervals.
preparation_correction: The lower arithmetic visibility endpoint is absent when its formula is negative. It is not clamped to an allegedly invisible T=0.
